title: 'Toxic' Crosses Rs 200 Crore: Yash film hits Rs 214.10 cr India net

title: Manisha holds back tears talking about Nepal floods: 'Can the pain be lessened?'

Nevertheless, she highlighted the crucial need for collective empowerment to heal and rebuild the affected communities.
